h001.cap: You are walking in the forest with your best friend. You are looking for a known treasure, said to give the power of the forest to the one who holds it. All of a sudden, an eerie silence fills the area.
h001.text: Hey, something’s up. [whisper|I don’t hear the birds anymore…]

choices.t: “Yeah, let’s figure out what’s going on.” (Proceed forward)
choices.say: Yeah, let’s figure out what’s going on.

h002.text: Zeke shakes his head and proceeds forward.

h003.text: You walk ahead of Zeke, checking out the clearing in front of you. The silence is unsettling; you know there should be the sound of [cold|weather or wildlife.]

h004.cap: Out of the forest in the distance, a figure is running towards you. You can’t tell if it is one of your kind.

h005.text: You trek back home, leaving Zeke to investigate alone.

choices.t: Alert your boss about Zeke’s whereabouts

h006.text: You get closer to the Endigo, stepping fully into the clearing. [shout|A scream erupts from the Endigo,] like an elk bugle from hell. It gestures toward your side of the forest with frantic arms. You get the impression it is [big|NOT] happy you are here.

choices.t: Re-enter your side of the forest

h007.text: You call out to the Endigo. [whisper|It does not respond.]

choices.t: Step into the clearing, drawing your weapon
Stay put, watching what the figure does

h008.text: Your boss asks why you left Zeke alone.

h010.text: A large beast [shout|explodes out of the trees,] looking at the figure. A wave of energy erupts from the beast, knocking the Endigo well into the air. [big|Its eyes lock onto you.]

h011.cap: Across the clearing, a large beast runs perpendicular to the figure. It does not enter the clearing; it seems the beast lost its prey. The Endigo approaches.
h011.text: What are you doing here? [big|Get away from here.]

choices.t: “We have gotten lost, can you help us?”
choices.say: We have gotten lost, can you help us?

h012.text: You aim your bow. [shout|The beast begins to charge you.]

h013.text: The beast charges at you. You do notice its front left leg [cold|has a wound already.]

h015.text: That treasure is [cold|not for you.] Do not continue your search. Entering this clearing is [big|certain death.] Those not of the forest spirit’s lineage will not be able to hold the treasure. Leave now.

choices.t: “No, we need this treasure. We will proceed.” (Enter the clearing)
choices.say: No, we need this treasure. We will proceed.

h016.cap: The Endigo points the way you came.
h016.text: Go that direction until you hit your people’s village. Do not enter this clearing. The forest will not be forgiving to your kind without a chaperone, and [cold|I do not have the time.]

h017.text: You arrive home. The end. [sad|You lose.]

h020.cap: The beast misses you by a hair, but makes contact with Zeke. As it rips your friend to shreds, the Endigo comes running over.
h020.text: [shout|GO HOME NOW.] [shout|THERE IS NO SAVING YOUR FRIEND.]

h021.text: The monster stumbles and slides to a halt in front of you. It struggles to get up several times. The Endigo approaches the beast with an [cold|eerie calm,] sliding a knife into its neck. [whisper|The beast goes still.]

h022.text: The shot glances off the beast [cold|like nothing.] It continues to charge you.
